notes.title: End of Official Operation of Certain Communities
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212740/c29d67bc6d8505c804d977373e5662a3b6c74971.png[/img]
Enter into the Endless Possibility!   
Hello, Admirals.

We inform you of the end of the official operation of Uncharted Waters Origin’s Steam community.

To deliver information promptly and consistently via our official Floor website,
we are ceasing the official operation of the Steam community, including notices and announcements.

We ask for your kind understanding, and please see below for the schedule.

⬛ Steam Community Closing Schedule
 - Dec. 4 (Wed) 2024

 * Please note that this change will not affect the game itself but will only end the official operation of the Steam community.
 * This change affects only the official operation of the community, including notices and announcements, and you can continue using the Steam community as you wish.

Upon the end of the official operation of the Steam community,

we will continue delivering diverse news via our official Floor website, so please visit our [[url=https://uwo.floor.line.games/us/main]Official Floor Website[/url]].

✅ ENG : https://uwo.floor.line.games/us/main 
✅ JPN : https://uwo.floor.line.games/jp/main

✅ CHT : https://uwo.floor.line.games/tw/main

💥Please stay tuned as we are holding diverse events on our official Floor website.

We hope for your unchanging interest in and support to Uncharted Waters Origin,
We will make an effort to provide more fun for Admirals.

Thank you.

notes.title: Additional Notice on Eastern Ship Privilege Issue Retrieval
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212740/c29d67bc6d8505c804d977373e5662a3b6c74971.png[/img]

Enter into the Endless Possibility! 
Hello, Admirals.

After the emergency maintenance on Jun. 9 (Fri), there was an issue where ‘Eastern Ship Privilege’ rewards could be claimed more than once. The issue was quickly resolved through a data patch.
We would like to apologize again for the inconvenience this issue caused.

This issue, where rewards for users who had purchased the Eastern Ship Privilege product in the past had reactivated, was found while we were fixing a different issue where the Eastern Ship Privilege product was not displayed on the Event ‘Privilege’ tab. 
We therefore found that from the Eastern Ship Privilege rewards, users had additionally received 5,000 Red Gems as a duplicate reward.

We regret that such an issue occurred, and therefore, in consideration of the fact that Red Gems are needed for various content, including draws and investment, and in order to ensure fairness for all users, we decided to retrieve the 5,000 Red Gems that were additionally received.

Before this measure was taken, some users had already used the duplicate 5,000 Red Gems they had received. After we retrieved the duplicate reward to ensure fairness, users who had less than 5,000 Free Red Gems ended up with minus Red Gems after the retrieval.

We would like to apologize for the fact that those users who now have minus Red Gems are unable to land or sail.

As Uncharted Waters Origin is a game that is heavily influenced by the flow of Currency, we have measures in place where we retrieve and withdraw Currency when any abusive or illegitimate transactions are detected. 
For such cases as these, we implement temporary restrictions in order to prevent additional victims, and such measures are applied in the same way for all countries where we service the game.

However, this particular case was not a case of illegitimate behavior, and we are fully aware that the inconvenience caused to your gameplay was caused by us.

Therefore, for those who experienced minus Red Gems after the retrieval, we will be establishing measures that will make landing/sailing possible, as well as other content, such as the use of Markets, possible with other Currencies besides Red Gems. This will be done through an additional patch, and we will proceed with the measures as soon as they are ready.

However, please understand that users with minus Red Gems will not be able to purchase items from the Auction House or use Red Gems as alternative payments.
Moreover, please understand that for the sake of fairness, we cannot recover any Red Gems for users who have minus Red Gems.


* Patch Schedule: Jun. 15 (Thu) 20:20 (UTC+9)
* Patch Details: Changes will be made so that for users who have minus Red Gems after the retrieval, they can land/sail and use Currencies apart from Red Gems (Blue Gems, Ducats etc.).


We would like to sincerely apologize again for the inconvenience caused.
We will continue to listen to users and strive for the utmost reliability and quality.

Thank you.

notes.title: [Account Security] Uncharted Waters Origin Security Services
notes.content:

Hello, Admirals.

This is an announcement regarding the account security services that are available to help keep your journey through Uncharted Waters Origin safe.

Please see below for more details.

[b][FLOOR OTP][/b]

■ FLOOR OTP
  - This service allows you to protect your account as you enter a one-time authentication number that is newly issued to you each time you run the FLOOR Launcher through the OTP program installed on your smartphone and log in to the game.

■ FLOOR OTP Installation
  - Go to the Appstore that corresponds with your OS and download FLOOR OTP

■ FLOOR OTP Registration Guide Page
  - Use the link below to find out how to register for OTP.
  - You will need to log in with your FLOOR account.
   ▶ FLOOR OTP Registration Guide Page [url=https://cs.line.games/floor/security/main][Link][/url]

■ To Note
※ To use FLOOR OTP, you will need a FLOOR account.
※ You will need to authenticate your identity to register for OTP.
※ To register for the OTP service, you must install an authentication application on your mobile device.
※ The OTP application may not be installed properly if you lack storage space on your device.

Please check your storage space before downloading the application.

※ Run the OTP program on your mobile phone to check the authentication number that has been issued.
※ The OTP service will be available for iPads soon.
※ If you cannot use the OTP program because you have deleted the application, misplaced or changed your device etc., you will need to cancel your OTP registration on the homepage and register again.


[b][Designated PC Registration]
[/b]

  - This is a service that will help you use FLOOR more conveniently.
